paragraphs: Mentioned at the beginning of Pesikta Rabbati, chapter 7, reporting in the name of R' Yitzchak. The Radal there reads R' Luliani bar Tavri.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פס׳ רבתי is contextually Pesikta Rabbati; רפ״ז is read as beginning of chapter 7, not 87 or literal 287. No named-edition numbering is verified. Radal romanizes הרד״ל; identification as David Luria is a conventional prior suggestion, not independently established here, so no full name/title is inserted.

Yulimna bar Avdi differs from the reported Luliani bar Tavri. The earlier provisional audit מר יוליכנא is not substituted for the supplied heading; provisional heading provenance remains unadjudicated. The reporting phrase adds no otherwise absent object. All three personal-title abbreviations remain R'.
